Comment by al...@bedatadriven.com:

General Comment:
Actually, jlapack is used by default, which are pure JVM classes and
platform independent. They are built with f2j, which compiles fortran to
jvm byte code.

netlib-java will only use native libraries if they are included in the
library path.
